record.title: Incorrect cost data in Costs API exports

updates.body: We have identified an issue causing incorrect cost data in Costs API exports published between November 6 and 9. We are working to correct the affected records and will provide an update once recovery is confirmed.
All affected services are operating normally again. We’re sorry for the disruption, and we appreciate your patience.
